author: PC Gamer
text:
9 new 2026 games on sale in the Steam Autumn Sale
Including three $70 games that are now under $50.

author: PC Gamer
text:
There's something even scarier than Huggy Wuggy in the Playtime toy factory this weekend
Poppy Playtime's multiplayer prequel, Escape from Playtime, is in open beta on Steam until Sunday.

author: PC Gamer
text:
There are so many games coming out in October you guys
We're all spoiled by choice this month.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Masters of Albion, Peter Molyneux's final game, just got a huge update and, [vigorous, lips-pursed nodding of approval], suddenly the old god game magic is back
And there's a tantalising, titan-sized teaser included, too

author: PC Gamer
text:
If Ace Combat's too pricey, this excellent indie alternative is on sale for just $12.50
And it's got better out-of-the-box HOTAS and VR support, too.

author: PC Gamer
text:
One story about my first 30 minutes in this post-apocalyptic robot game led multiple people to buy it
Radiosol released on Steam this week.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'Open world fatigue' is one reason indie RPG Entropy is borrowing from the classics: 'PS1, PS2, GameCube games really never outstayed their welcome'
Except Drakengard.

author: PC Gamer
text:
How to conquer Kuttenberg
Bypassing Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2's main quest by taking Kuttenberg myself.

author: PC Gamer
text:
More than 450 Witcher 3 mods have already been updated to support the Remastered version
That's a lotta mods!

author: PC Gamer
text:
Kingdom Come: Deliverance studio co-founder hopes Grand Theft Auto 6 will 'blaze a trail' to higher game prices
Warhorse co-founder Martin Klima says games keep getting more expensive to make, and that money has to come from somewhere.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'We needed a potentially infinite resource of party members so that we could then kill them:' Entropy dev James Wragg explains how you fit permadeath in a party RPG
Human Resources.

author: PC Gamer
text:
At last: I can build a home out of raw Windows Vista-era nostalgia
Frutiger Home is a house builder for those who yearn for the glossiest time in tech.

author: PC Gamer
text:
That's some fiiiiine lookin' milk, but Rust devs warn that 'cream is a more powerful consumable'
Rust's October update brings livestock and their various excretions to the survival game.

author: PC Gamer
text:
You can now buy more than 44,000 games for $5 or less on Steam
That's right: The 2026 Steam Autumn Sale is live.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Grand Theft Auto 5 is a game about shapeshifting now. I don't make the rules
I mean, I guess I sort of do.

author: PC Gamer
text:
After a series of catastrophes where no-one could seem to roll well, I truly have no idea who's going to make it out of Critical Role's next episode
I am on the edge of my seat.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Resident Evil's executive producer explains the deeper meaning behind Requiem, and I just can't get on board
I'm gnawing at the bars of my enclosure.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Sound the 'This week's free Epic Games Store game is worth logging in for' alarm
Nightdive's System Shock 2 is a superlative remaster of the best game with 'Shock' in its title, and it's free.

author: PC Gamer
text:
You can now play Halo: Combat Evolved in a web browser, and it even has multiplayer
Fancy a 1v1?

author: PC Gamer
text:
Great news, cowards: The Witcher 3's most yellow-bellied mod works with the remaster
What's the matter? Scared of a little meat on your witcher?

author: PC Gamer
text:
Don't fear the BIOS update: Asus has just fixed a local access vulnerability affecting older Intel motherboards
To be clear, it's only older motherboards for 8th and 9th Gen Intel CPUs that are affected by the issue.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Gears of War: E-Day system requirements require ray tracing-capable graphics card to play, alongside 115 GB of free space on an SSD
The game's minimum requirements are pretty forgiving.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Where to find the Nangan region Treasure Hunt in Forza Horizon 6
Smash this chest at the space center.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Google Japan's conveyor belt keyboard is a sad reminder of the sense of humour the whole company used to have long, long ago
Google Japan has form, pity it's seemingly the only bit of Google that still does.

author: PC Gamer
text:
This arse cushion is the biggest upgrade I've made to my gaming setup in 2026, which says a lot about where we're at right now
In short, I've been sitting on it.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I am here to save us all time by determining which of our most-played videogames would be more efficiently completed if you had a gun
Astarion probably shouldn't have a glock.

author: PC Gamer
text:
AOC jumps on the 1,000 Hz IPS gaming monitor bandwagon but this time with 0.1 ms pixel response
The fastest LCD panel yet?

author: PC Gamer
text:
Roll up roll up, can you spot which of these images are using DLSS 5?
I swear, it gets harder as you scroll down.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Gears of War: E-Day review in progress — Good shooting, but the campaign's a slog
Gears has never felt better to play, or more creatively stagnant.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Arc Raiders' is taking no prisoners when it comes to cheaters with permanent bans becoming the new normal: 'No warnings. No second chances'
Embark is really pulling out all the stops for Frozen Trail.
